tickets.title: Coordinate concentrated position review
tickets.text: Review Lyra Maplesprocket’s Moonbadger 529 Program account at Velvet Acorn Custody against the expected distribution schedule for Marzipan Meadow University. Address the meaningful equity allocation despite near-term tuition spending and Selene’s request for a short-horizon review.

subTasks.title: Analyze portfolio concentration and risk exposure
subTasks.text: Measure position size relative to total portfolio, sector exposure, volatility, downside scenarios, and diversification alternatives. Provide evidence for the advisor recommendation.

subTasks.title: Review equity compensation or insider constraints
subTasks.text: If the position relates to employer equity, confirm vesting status, exercise history, blackout windows, trading plan considerations, and any client-reported restrictions that affect timing.

subTasks.title: Estimate tax impact of reduction strategies
subTasks.text: Review unrealized gain or loss, holding periods, charitable gifting options, tax-loss offset availability, estimated tax payment needs, and CPA coordination points.

subTasks.title: Confirm operational and compliance readiness
subTasks.text: Check documentation, trading authorization, account restrictions, suitability notes, and required approvals before any implementation instructions are prepared.

tickets.evidence: Mira’s review noted that the Lyra 529 account still has a meaningful equity allocation despite near-term tuition spending, and Selene wanted the account reviewed against the expected distribution schedule.

tickets.title: Compare student loan decision options
tickets.text: Compare the offered federal student loan, additional cash, taxable-account liquidation, and home equity line of credit before Lyra’s school acceptance window closes. Use the home equity line terms review and the student loan decision comparison completed on 2026-05-10 as reference.
tickets.evidence: The discussion was prompted by the aid package’s federal student loan offer and Selene’s request for a comparison of using the offered student loan, additional cash, taxable-account liquidation, or the home equity line before the school’s acceptance window closes.

tickets.title: Review home equity line terms for education bridge funding
tickets.text: Review the Silver Marmot Bank home equity line terms for education bridge funding. Confirm the current rate formula, draw procedure, payment terms, and any inactivity limitations during the meeting.
tickets.evidence: Selene could confirm that the Silver Marmot Bank line is unused but could not provide the current rate formula, draw procedure, payment terms, or any inactivity limitations during the meeting.

tickets.title: Start self-employed plan setup review
tickets.text: Restore Selene Maplesprocket’s secure portal access after the document folder was locked following repeated rejections of the Marzipan Meadow University aid letter file. Verify identity according to firm procedure and document the resolution path.

tickets.title: Review collected tax documents
tickets.text: Review the submitted tax materials for completeness and planning relevance. Confirm that the household’s 2025 federal and Oregon tax returns, W-2, 1099, K-1, retirement distribution, Social Security, and other income forms are collected. Flag any items requiring CPA confirmation and note planning opportunities related to withholding, estimated payments, loss harvesting, charitable strategy, retirement contributions, or equity compensation timing.
tickets.evidence: The household’s 2025 federal tax return showed adjusted gross income of $356,400 and did not claim an education credit for Lyra. The household’s 2025 Oregon return reported $7,200 of contributions to Moonbadger 529 Program accounts.
